component.name: Loopcatcher
component.summary: Capture Linux loopback audio to AAC or OGG files

description.p: Loopcatcher is a Linux TUI tool for capturing loopback audio from PulseAudio/PipeWire sinks into organized, auto-tagged audio files.

It routes an application sink input into a monitor sink and encodes the loopback audio into AAC or OGG while preserving track metadata when it is available. It provides interactive TUI controls and stores its runtime configuration under ~/.config/loopcatcher.

Rebuilt the TUI on charmbracelet/gum. Adds player profiles with player-scoped MPRIS monitoring, a first-run-only onboarding wizard, a guided no-sink setup wizard, automatic session end, and in-app about/license viewers.
Relicense the project under the MIT License and ship AppStream MetaInfo and desktop integration.
First release as loopcatcher: generic loopback capture, interactive TUI with runtime config menu, session output handling, and Debian packaging with desktop integration.
